name: Library Article-Aware Sorting
changes: Sorts Automation TV Shows and Movies by title while ignoring a leading English article A, An, or The for alphabetical placement.
Keeps the original title text unchanged everywhere; only the temporary library sort key ignores the leading article.
Uses the full displayed title, then year and media id as deterministic tie-breakers when article-stripped sort keys are equal.
Preserves all v3.6.95 themes, layout, Automation behavior beyond library presentation order, downloading, updater ownership, and Defender-clean native helper architecture.
regression_guards: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms sorts under Knight, The Legend of Vox Machina sorts under Legend, and An American title sorts under American.
Only whole leading A, An, or The words followed by whitespace are ignored; titles such as Theodore and Annihilation are not modified for sorting.
Visible TV and Movie titles remain unchanged and both Automation library tabs continue to use the shared comparator.
v3.6.95 styles.css, themes.css, theme persistence/readability, backend Automation logic, and Defender-clean Picker/yEnc/update architecture remain unchanged.
